offer.text: The dark brings monsters to our walls. Stand watch with me tonight — clear five of the undead before dawn and the village sleeps safe.

accept.text: Good. Keep your blade ready and your eyes open.

decline.text: Then I'll watch alone, as ever.

in_progress.text: Still some lurking in the dark. Five, before sunrise.

ready.text: Dawn's near and the streets are clear. Well watched.

complete.text: Another night the village wakes whole. My thanks, watcher.

failed.text: Dawn came and the work was unfinished. Tomorrow night, then.
